# image-size compatibility fixtures

Unmodified valid images from the MIT-licensed [image-size source](https://github.com/image-size/image-size/tree/5c065e6949065c0015d2e8e6aced5c67280dfda2/specs/images/valid). Each filename prefixes its upstream format directory. The source license is retained in LICENSE.image-size. These fixtures verify real ICNS, JXL container/codestream, AVIF and HEIC detection after the reviewed parser bounds patch.
